notes.title: ✅ Bug Fix Update – Death Scene Freeze Resolved
notes.notes: [p]Good news, everyone![/p][p]I just released a patch that [b]fully fixes the issue where the death scene could occasionally get stuck[/b]. The game should now transition smoothly every time.[/p][p]Also, if you experience any bugs or issues in the future, feel free to post them in the Community Hub or Discussions — we’re actively monitoring and committed to delivering quick fixes.[/p][p]Thanks for playing and supporting the game![/p]
